verdict.rationale: The evidence only touches the story indirectly. Dispute information can be retrieved via the Disputes API, so a team could compute and export dispute data themselves. Risk experiments A/B test profiles to see which 'performs better', which hints at approval or fraud comparison metrics, and case management implies a review queue exists. None of this documents a finance-facing metrics view or export. Missing for 10: a documented dashboard or report showing dispute rate, false-positive rate, approval-rate lift and review-workload metrics; a board-ready export (CSV/PDF/scheduled reports); and independent or hands-on corroboration of reporting quality.
